svg.title: Replicazeron STM32F103 wiring diagram
svg.desc: Assembly wiring for the 6 by 5 key harness, STM32F103 Blue Pill header, OLED, analog thumbstick, status LEDs and addressable lighting interface.
svg.text: Point-to-point assembly wiring · STM32F103 Blue Pill · sheet 1/1

g.text: USB connector at top · header labels shown
PB14 RGB · PB13 LED L · PB12 LED R
PA15, PB3 AND PB4 MUST BE AVAILABLE AS GPIO (NOT JTAG)
Pull-ups, if absent on module: 4.7 kΩ to +3V3.
One push button, two isolated terminals; D30 band/bar faces ROW_5.
GPIO low = LED on. Each bare LED requires its own resistor.
Addressable RGB data · choose one interface from the strip specification
Fit if 3.3 V data is not supported
DIRECT BYPASS when DIN accepts 3.3 V
If DIN accepts 3.3 V: omit U2 and use PB14 → 330Ω → DIN. Otherwise fit U2. Always use common ground.
STM32F103 INPUTS ARE NOT 5 V TOLERANT
• Power joystick and OLED from the Blue Pill 3V3 header.
• Keep GPIO and ADC signals within 0–3.3 V.
• All supplies, Blue Pill and peripherals require common ground.
• Do not backfeed the USB 5 V rail from an external supply
unless the power path is isolated or power-ORed.
• Verify polarity, continuity and voltage before plugging in USB.
Connect matching harness labels point-to-point. Conductors may use any colors; label both ends by signal.
Detailed circuit notes, harness map and bring-up procedure: pages 2–3.
